title: Vibrant Umami Indian Paneer Rasmalai
description: A satvik-friendly, crowd-pleasing Indian dessert featuring crunchy sesame butter and brine-wet paneer, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Soak the paneer in water for 30 minutes to make it brine-wet.
Crush the cardamom powder in a mortar and pestle to release its aroma.
Combine the milk, sugar, and salt in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove the paneer from the water and cut it into small cubes.
Dip each paneer cube into the milk mixture and then roll it in sesame butter to coat.
Place the coated paneer cubes on a plate and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle chopped pistachios and a pinch of cardamom powder over the paneer cubes.
Drizzle rose water over the top and serve chilled.
